title: English Practice Quiz 0083
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: She is ___ university student.
questions.explanation: University begins with the consonant sound /y/, so use a.

questions.question: It ___ rain later; take an umbrella.
Which word has the /ʃ/ sound as in 'ship'?
Choose the correct WH question for a place.
questions.explanation: Where asks about a place or location.

questions.question: I have ___ my keys.
questions.explanation: Lost is the past participle of lose.

questions.question: She said, 'I can swim.'
options: She said that she could swim.
questions.explanation: Can commonly changes to could in reported speech after a past reporting verb.

questions.question: Please drive ___.
questions.explanation: Carefully is the adverb modifying drive.

questions.question: This is the woman ___ helped me.
A person who repairs water pipes is a ___.
questions.explanation: A plumber installs and repairs water pipes and fittings.

questions.question: He wants to become ___ engineer.
questions.explanation: Engineer begins with a vowel sound, so use an.
